insert into settlement_detail (settlement_id, work_hour_id, student_id, position_id, work_date, hours, hourly_wage, coefficient, amount, create_time) values
(#{detail.settlementId}, #{detail.workHourId}, #{detail.studentId}, #{detail.positionId}, #{detail.workDate}, #{detail.hours}, #{detail.hourlyWage}, #{detail.coefficient}, #{detail.amount}, #{detail.createTime})
mapper.select: select sd.*, s.name as studentName, s.student_no as studentNo, p.name as positionName from settlement_detail sd left join student s on sd.student_id = s.id left join position p on sd.position_id = p.id where sd.settlement_id = #{settlementId} order by sd.student_id asc, sd.work_date asc, sd.id asc
select ifnull(sum(amount), 0) as totalAmount, ifnull(sum(hours), 0) as totalHours, count(1) as detailCount from settlement_detail where settlement_id = #{settlementId}
